==============================================================================================================
QCR MECHANISM / SCHRIEFFER-WOLFF VALIDATION
no imposed generator; only the physical off-resonant blue-sideband drive is propagated
==============================================================================================================

MODEL
  H(t) = (Omega_sb/2) * ( |l><g| (x) a_dag * exp(-i delta_disp t) + h.c. )
  interaction picture; no RWA beyond this; no Schrieffer-Wolff; no secular approx
  qudit d = 3  levels = ('g', 'l', 's')   ('s' is never driven)
  Fock cutoff = 8   Hilbert dim = 24

PARAMETERS
  Omega_sb/2pi    =     4.0000 kHz   MEASURED (Meth EDF 2c, innsbruck_meth_2025)
  delta_disp/2pi  =    40.0000 kHz   ***ASSUMED*** (not in Meth)
  Omega_sb        = 2.513274e-02 rad/us
  delta_disp      = 2.513274e-01 rad/us

  chi_pred = Omega_sb^2 / (4 * delta_disp)
           = (2.513274e-02)^2 / (4 * 2.513274e-01)
           = 6.316547e-04 / 1.005310e+00
           = 6.283185e-04 rad/us
  chi_pred/2pi = 100.000000 Hz          DERIVED from the two above
  (chi_pred inherits the ASSUMED delta_disp: chi ~ 1/delta_disp)

INTEGRATOR
  qutip.propagator   atol=1e-11  rtol=1e-09
  short window: T = 25.465 us, 41 samples, max_step = 0.05 us
  long  window: T = 5000.0 us, 241 samples, max_step = 0.5 us
  fastest timescale 2pi/delta_disp = 25.0000 us

propagating short window (41 samples to T_QCR = 25.465 us) ...
  done

    full |U| in basis {g,l,s} x {n=0..7}, then transfer summaries
